# Credit Portfolio Appraisal Notes

This document details urgent actions required for the credit portfolio:

*   Monitor the standard update of interest rates.
*   Optimize interest rates urgently.
*   Update collateral values based on audit findings.
*   Update borrower credit scores based on audit findings.
*   Investigate default risk based on audit findings.
